dialogues.speaker: View Hint
dialogues.text: If you wish to end conflict, then have one <color=#00E1FFFF>ascend to the heights</color>, while the other reposes upon low ground.

dialogues.speaker: View Hint
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>The flowers in wild fields</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>the fruit of the earth</color> shall bring comfort to the creature who dwells in the valley low.
